title: RPA Developer
summary: An RPA developer builds software robots (bots) that copy the clicks and typing people do in business systems, using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere or Power Automate Desktop. They usually sit in an automation team or shared services centre and work with finance, HR and operations staff to remove repetitive work.
dailyDuties: Study a manual process with business users and map each step
Write the process and solution design documents
Build and test bots with exception handling and logging
Deploy bots to the orchestrator and schedule their runs
Fix failed bot runs and changes in target screens
Report hours saved and bot run results to the team
